entries.claim: African Bank Limited is a registered bank under the Banks Act; registration 2014/176899/06; FSP 46904; NCR registration NCRCP7638
entries.source_ref: African Bank Limited AFS 30 September 2025; African Bank catalogue PDF

entries.claim: African Bank is listed as a locally controlled bank on the SARB Prudential Authority register; HQ 59 16th Road, Midrand; CEO Kennedy Bungane
entries.source_ref: SARB Locally Controlled Banks list as at 1 September 2025

entries.claim: African Bank Holdings Limited shareholders comprise the SARB, a consortium of six banks, the GEPF managed by the PIC, and the iKamva Lethu employee trust
entries.source_ref: African Bank Holdings Limited interim results, six months ended 31 March 2025

entries.claim: MyWorld Account has no monthly fee, one transactional account plus up to five linked pockets, overdraft access up to R100,000, and shared-banking features

Audacious Rewards pays points for everyday banking (savings, loan repayment, card swipes, buying airtime/electricity) redeemable for airtime, data, groceries, travel and entertainment; points are credited only after the qualifying transaction clears
entries.source_ref: audaciousrewards.co.za/faq; Audacious Rewards Terms and Conditions v29 (2025-06-24)

entries.claim: African Bank supports tap-to-pay via Samsung Wallet, Garmin Pay and SwatchPay
H1 FY2025 (six months to 31 March 2025) group net profit after tax rose 15% to R202 million
entries.source_ref: African Bank Holdings Limited Interim Financial Results, six months ended 31 March 2025

entries.claim: FY2025 (year to 30 September 2025): net income from operations before impairments R7,601m; credit impairments R2,440m (-6%); credit loss ratio improved to 5.3% from 6.3%; total income before expenses R5,161m (+5%)
entries.source_ref: SENS release of audited FY2025 results, 24 November 2025

entries.claim: Press reports a FY2025 net loss of about R624 million attributed to transformation and integration costs
entries.source_ref: African News Agency / press reporting on African Bank FY2025 results

entries.claim: African Bank acquired Grindrod Bank and Ubank (2022) and plans a JSE relisting in 2027; iKamva Lethu 10% staff scheme is live
